title: eat shit & die 213
author: bpatrick
body: Trent’s boss is actually named after one my favorite bosses. It’s not much of an homage, I’m afraid.

comments.author: AJ
comments.text: i thought the point of eat, shit and die was that you missed out the fuck?

comments.author: johhnydollar
comments.text: I never thought of it that way…man, I thought porn was pretty boring, but now it’s much hotter to think of the girls as desperate, helpless and reluctant. Thanks, man!

comments.author: RatB
comments.text: @AJ You may not fuck, but it wouldn’t feel like ESAD if you couldn’t get fucked.

comments.author: WolffBrosef2
comments.text: The difference between Trent’s situation and porn is that Trent was expecting his job to be only pizza-related (as well he should), whereas people working in the porn industry, helpless as they might be at times, surely realize from the start that their ‘job’ is sex-related.
